formula_or_definition: Fraction of planned cases for which a rewrite method emits candidate SQL
denominator: Approved planned candidate cases such as Track A same-engine case-engine opportunities
notes: Generation means candidate SQL emission only; extraction/readiness diagnostics are separate

formula_or_definition: Fraction of planned candidate cases that reach execution
denominator: Approved planned candidate cases for the method and scope

formula_or_definition: Fraction of executed candidate cases whose observed result is consistent with expected result
denominator: Executed candidate cases for the approved method and scope

formula_or_definition: Fraction of verifier-decidable result-consistent cases with approved semantic-equivalence support
notes: Unknown and undecidable cases reported separately

formula_or_definition: Geometric mean speedup over result-consistent timed cases
Percentile summary such as P25 median/P50 P75 and optional IQR over speedup ratios
notes: Renamed from Speedup Distribution; replaces Regression@20 as primary framing

formula_or_definition: Fraction of attribution-eligible cases with sufficient operator-level attribution evidence
denominator: Attribution-eligible cases under approved attribution schema
not_computable_condition: Attribution schema or denominator not defined
notes: Implementation deferred; atom-based observability score is support design only

formula_or_definition: Fraction of approved cross-engine candidate cases that execute on target engine
denominator: Approved cross-engine candidate cases under portability/generalization scope
not_computable_condition: No approved portability denominator or target engine unsupported
notes: Separate from Track A same-engine denominator

formula_or_definition: Fraction of executed cross-engine candidate cases that produce consistent target-engine results
denominator: Executed cross-engine candidate cases unless later approved denominator differs
notes: Separate from same-engine Result Consistency Rate

formula_or_definition: Retained speedup ratio across paired source-engine and target-engine timing evidence
denominator: Paired source/target result-consistent timed candidate cases
not_computable_condition: Paired target-engine timing unavailable or unsupported
notes: Report N.A. when paired timing is missing

formula_or_definition: Counts by failure_stage and failure_type within compatible scopes
notes: Diagnostic only; Candidate Failure Rate removed as primary

formula_or_definition: Diagnostic status for extraction and parser acceptance
denominator: Generated or submitted candidate SQL scope
notes: Not a primary Generation Rate variant

formula_or_definition: Diagnostic status for execution readiness or runnable SQL boundary
denominator: Generated or submitted candidate SQL scope
notes: Separate from executed and result consistency

formula_or_definition: Plan artifact availability or plan-observability support summary
notes: Support evidence for attribution; not primary explainability metric

formula_or_definition: Legacy threshold comparison over result-consistent timed cases if needed
